marketing_description: The Speed Queen® Sanitizing Gas Dryer (part number DR7004BG) delivers a 7 cu‑ft capacity and 710 rpm rotational speed, powered by a 22,000 Btu/hr gas motor and a 1/3 hp drum motor. Its galvanized steel drum, 43‑in height, 26‑7/8‑in width, 28‑in depth, and 51‑1/2‑in depth with door open accommodate commercial loads while the 11 cycles, 5 temperature settings, and 120‑V voltage rating provide flexible operation. Built‑in features such as anti‑static, commercial cool‑down technology, extended tumble, lint filter guard, moisture sensor, pet‑plus, and steam options (boost, refresh, sanitize) along with 220 cfm exhaust airflow, 4‑in exhaust outlet, and 3/8‑in gas inlet support efficient, hygienic drying for trade environments.
